sources.quote: Claude Haiku 4.5 is available everywhere today. If you’re a developer, simply use claude-haiku-4-5 via the Claude API. Pricing is now $1/$5 per million input and output tokens.
sources.supports: Anthropic's October 15, 2025 launch announcement states that API pricing was $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens from launch.

sources.quote: A cache hit costs 10% of the standard input price
sources.supports: Anthropic documents the cache read price as 10% of standard input pricing; applied to the launch input price of $1, that is $0.10 per million tokens.

notes: Anthropic's launch announcement establishes $1/$5 input/output pricing on October 15, 2025, so the earlier $3/$15 catalog entry was not its official API price. Anthropic's cache pricing documentation gives cache hits at 10% of input; no provider source located states a more precise change time or a before/after bracket.
